subject: Re: Post-call: Pricing & budget validation for PayBridge
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paybridge.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: PayBridge + Redwood pricing (post-call recap)

Thanks Alex — great convo earlier. Summary and next steps below.

Call summary
- Use case: realtime transactional inference for payments reconciliation + customer support routing.
- Typical payload: short prompts (average ~60 tokens in + 80 tokens out) for classification + generation.
- Expected volume (first 6 months): 50M - 150M tokens/month depending on pilot success.

Pricing / budget qualification (from call)
- You mentioned target unit economics around $/1M tokens in the range you expect; we discussed a target of ~$300-$450 per 1M tokens to be competitive relative to your current spend.
- Budget band you indicated: $25k-$60k / month depending on volume.
- Procurement + approval: you said procurement needs quotes for anything above ~$50k/month; below ~25k is typically handled by the product/engineering budget.

What I need from you to formalize a quote
1) Confirm an initial pilot target (low/med/high): e.g., 50M / 100M / 150M tokens per month.
2) Finance contact for procurement + PO process (if >$50k/mo).
3) Any security/compliance docs required early (SOC2, IP/DSA) — we can attach SOC2 and our standard DPA.

Next steps
- I will send a concise pricing estimate with three monthly spend scenarios and a mutual action plan.
- If the numbers look good, we can schedule procurement/finance + legal sync next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Redwood_pricing_estimate_PayBridge.pdf (pricing scenarios)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: PayBridge + Redwood pricing (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap, this is helpful.

Quick clarifications:
- Pilot target: let's aim for a medium pilot at ~100M tokens/month to start. That should capture realistic load (peak reconciliation windows).
- Budget: finance is comfortable in the $30k-$45k / month band for the initial run depending on unit price and SLA.
- Procurement: correct — anything above $50k/month needs a formal procurement/contracting review. For that path I'll loop in procurement (procurement@paybridge.com).
- Security: SOC2 report is required; please include it in the follow-up.

I also want a simple per-1M token line item and an expected monthly spend table so I can share with my VP of Platform.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Engineering, PayBridge
alex.johnson@paybridge.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@paybridge.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: PayBridge + Redwood pricing (post-call recap)

Alex — attaching the estimate and MAP. High-level pricing scenarios below (all figures are list price before any term-based discounts):

Pricing assumptions (examples)
- Unit: $ per 1M input+output tokens (combined).
- Baseline model: Redwood-curated open model (quantized) for transactional LLM tasks.

Scenarios
1) Low (50M tokens/mo)
  - Unit price: $350 / 1M tokens
  - Monthly spend: 50 * $350 = $17,500 / month
2) Medium (100M tokens/mo)
  - Unit price: $325 / 1M tokens
  - Monthly spend: 100 * $325 = $32,500 / month
3) High (150M tokens/mo)
  - Unit price: $300 / 1M tokens (volume discount tier applies >=120M)
  - Monthly spend: 150 * $300 = $45,000 / month

Notes on discounts & commitments
- We can offer a standard enterprise tier discount (typically 10-15%) for 12-month committed spend. Deeper discounts available for multi-year deals or higher committed volumes.
- Procurement thresholds: formal contracting + SOW required for monthly spends > $50k; otherwise we can proceed with our standard order form.

Attachments included
- Redwood_pricing_estimate_PayBridge.pdf (detailed table + unit economics)
- Mutual_Action_Plan_PayBridge.docx (timeline + owners)
- Redwood_SOC2_type2.pdf (security report)

Next steps
- Let me know which scenario you want modeled in a formal quote and I'll produce an official PDF/DocuSign packet.
- If procurement needs contract language, I'll loop in legal and send a clean PO-ready quote.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: Redwood_pricing_estimate_PayBridge.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan_PayBridge.docx, Redwood_SOC2_type2.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-17T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: PayBridge - budget validation & procurement (need pricing signoff)

Folks — forwarding the thread with PayBridge (Alex). They want a medium pilot at ~100M tokens/mo and are targeting $30k-$45k/month. Procurement triggers for them kick in above ~$50k/mo.

Ask:
- Can we price the formal quote at the medium scenario with a 12-month commit discount option (10-15%)? I drafted list-price numbers below (from attached estimate).
- Procurement: if they end up at ~150M/mo and breach $50k monthly, procurement/legal will require an SOW and contracting. Heads up for potential legal loop-in.

Quick reference (list price)
- 100M/mo = $32,500 / month at $325 / 1M tokens
- Recommend we present a 12-month committed option at 12% off list in the first-year to land this.

Would appreciate signoff on the discount range and whether we should pre-authorize a PO-based onboarding credit (e.g., 1 month free) for pilots that convert to committed terms.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: PayBridge - budget validation & procurement (need pricing signoff)

Marissa / Dylan — OK to proceed.
- Approve a 12% first-year discount on the 12-month committed option for the medium scenario (100M/mo).
- Approve a one-month onboarding credit if they sign a 12-month commitment within 30 days of the pilot.
- If they expand to >120M/mo (volume tier), escalate for a deeper discount discussion but we can offer the listed tier pricing of $300/1M as presented.

Please prepare the formal quote with those terms and include SOC2 + DPA as attachments. I'll loop in legal only if procurement pushes for special contract language.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
